category_basis: Ensor died 19 November 1949; the Belgian term (life+70) expired in 2020. Every work shown predates 1930, so each is public domain in both Belgium (life+70) and the US (pre-1930 publication). Some files are museum photographs under CC0/CC BY of public-domain paintings — noted per image; fine for personal use with attribution.
